evidence.excerpt: We introduce PrivDrift, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7% to 54.6%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity.
